data.name: Dr. Gregory Thorne
data.occupation: Chief of Critical Toxicology & Emergency Medicine
knowledge: Ambassador Vance exhibits non-standard cholinesterase depression (<28%).
Standard pralidoxime failed to reverse neuromuscular block.
Suspects synthetic fluorophosphate analog with lipophilic carrier solvent.
secrets: St. Jude board was pressured by private donor to suppress public pathogen reports.
currentConcerns: Cellular degradation of Vance blood samples without high-res mass spec.
Potential contamination of ICU staff if compound is vapor-active.
